errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос (ос x) съдържа текстови етикети, описващи всеки индикатор
errors.evidence: In a horizontal bar chart, the vertical axis (y-axis) displays the categories (text labels), while the horizontal axis (x-axis) represents the numerical values. The description incorrectly reverses this.

errors.text_span: като редът е азбучен по текста на етикетите
errors.evidence: The categories are not sorted alphabetically. For example, the first label starts with 'Ф' and the second with 'П'. The bars are sorted in descending order of their percentage values, a fact which is correctly mentioned later in the description, creating a contradiction.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос (ос y) е неявна, но представлява скала на проценти
errors.evidence: In a horizontal bar chart, the horizontal axis (x-axis) represents the numerical scale (percentages in this case), not the vertical axis.
